item.title: Martin O’Neill puts Champions League collapse among most painful Celtic nights
item.summary: Celtic lose to Lask in qualifier from 4-0 up on aggregate ‘That’s my team and that’s my responsibility,’ O’Neill says Martin O’Neill has admitted Celtic’s Champions League qualifying collapse from 4-0 up ranks as one of his most painful nights as the club’s manager. Celtic held a four-goal aggregate lead against Lask on Tuesday when Callum McGregor scored in the 21st minute in Austria, building on a 3-0 first-leg victory , and appeared to be cruising into the league stage. But they lost 5-1 on the night after extra time to go out in extraordinary fashion. Continue reading...
